metric.name: completed comparable delivery units per ISO week

manualBaseline.label: Manual coding aggregate baseline
manualBaseline.deliveryUnit: One coherent user-value work cluster in the Parallix predecessor repository, classified by the retained retrospective from its 2022 Git history; it is not a Git commit.

observations.note: The retained source names the nine clusters and their fixed observation period, but does not preserve auditable per-week cluster dates. This baseline is therefore an aggregate rate, never plotted as invented weekly observations.

limitations: Historical aggregate from a different product phase and codebase maturity.
Observational one-maintainer data, not a controlled benchmark.
The graph uses the aggregate rate as a reference line only.

parallix.source: Canonical lifecycle mission outcomes: integration-to-done lifecycle completion across all classifications; exported without mission identities or telemetry.
